accueil.h1: Your AI film studio, open source, on ComfyUI.
accueil.sub: Create your characters and sets, scout a real place, stage your shot in 3D, then shoot and cut your film.
accueil.sub2: Everything runs on your own Comfy account, with a quote before every credit.
accueil.showLead: A character who keeps the same face from shot to shot, a set made from a text or a photo, a real place scouted on the map. All with ComfyUI models.

start.k: start begin first steps sign up getting started works guide
start.a: Pick a tool, or start with CAST to create your character. To run a render, tap “Sign in with Comfy”: the render runs on your Comfy Cloud account, and every button tells you ≈ how many credits it costs before it starts. The “Get started” guide below shows the 4 steps.

free.k: free pay paid money without paying trial
free.a: Image, video, sound and 3D renders run on your Comfy Cloud account and are paid in Comfy credits. Uttu, the estimator, touring the studio and scouting a place on the map launch no render. The studio charges nothing.

subscription.q: Do I need a Comfy subscription?
subscription.k: subscription standard plan tier pricing price monthly api
subscription.a: Yes, to run renders: they go through the Comfy Cloud API. According to Comfy’s pricing page, API access is included in plans from Standard up. Prices are on comfy.org/cloud/pricing: check them there, I don’t make any up.

credits.k: buy credits top up balance recharge
credits.a: Every Comfy Cloud subscription includes credits, and you can buy more at any time on your Comfy account (Settings → Plans & Credits). The studio doesn’t sell credits; your balance shows under “My credits” once your account is linked.

key.q: Where do I paste my API key?
key.k: api key paste link connect account token
key.a: Create a key on platform.comfy.org (API Keys → + New) and copy it right away: it is shown only once. Then tap “Connect my Comfy account” in the guide below and paste it.

keySafe.k: safe security key server share leak stolen
keySafe.a: Your key stays on this device; the studio doesn’t keep it on a server. Don’t share it with anyone. If it leaks, delete it on platform.comfy.org and create a new one.

cost.q: How much does a render cost?
cost.k: cost price how much credits expensive estimate
cost.a: Every tool shows its estimate before the gesture, in “credits estimated”. For a total, write for example “3 portraits + 2 LTX takes”, or open the estimator below.

estimate.k: estimated measured quote exact difference hypothesis
estimate.a: “Estimated” comes from the studio’s table, not yet measured on a real render. “Measured” comes from a render already billed. The exact quote shows in the tool, before you confirm.

cancel.k: cancel stop abort render job sent interrupt
cancel.a: Once a render is sent to Comfy, the studio never cancels it. If the page closes, “Recover the render” reads the job already sent, without starting a new one. A new render always needs its quote and your confirmation.

fail.k: failed failure error broken stuck render recover
fail.a: Open “Jobs and recovery” in the production plan: it shows the job’s state. Recovering reads the job already sent. Starting a new render always needs a new quote and your confirmation.

tabs.k: tabs steps organisation sections cast set take edit
tabs.a: The studio follows four steps: Cast (your characters), Set (your places), Take (your video shots) and Edit (you assemble and export). “Tools” gathers every Comfy tool by family.

projects.k: projects backup storage files saved device zip export
projects.a: Your projects are saved in this browser, on this device. You reopen them from “My creations”. Remember to download a backup: the browser can erase its data when space runs low.

local.k: uttu works model ai intelligence local offline sends
local.a: I run in your browser with no AI model: I search a studio sheet built at every release. I send nothing and spend nothing.

who.k: who are you introduce name uttu
who.a: I’m Uttu, the U*TTU studio guide. I explain the steps, answer common questions and estimate costs. For an action in your project, I hand over to the production plan.

agent.k: agent paid comfy fuller free conversation future soon
agent.a: Yes: Comfy agent mode understands open-ended requests. It runs on your linked Comfy account, each message is paid by your account, and its estimated cost shows before the first send. The agent launches nothing: it suggests an action, you click. Without a linked account, I stay the local guide.

openWeights.k: open weights open partner proprietary hidden option settings
openWeights.a: A “partner” tool calls a paid proprietary model through Comfy. In your model settings you can keep only open models: partner tools are then hidden.
